turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is a reminder that your EMI of Rs 4,500 is overdue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes I know, salary got delayed. I will pay Rs 4,500 on Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, I will note that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your credit card payment is due.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was charged twice for the same purchase, this is unacceptable. I didn't make the second transaction.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, let me raise a dispute.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Calling about your outstanding loan instalment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm fed up with these calls. I want to speak to your manager, otherwise I will complain to the ombudsman.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your EMI is due on the 5th.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for reminding me. I'll transfer Rs 12,000 tomorrow.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, have a good day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I just wanted to know my branch timings.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our branch is open 10 to 4.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your payment of Rs 8,200 is overdue by 15 days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can't pay right now, I lost my job. Please give me some time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will note your request.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Calling about a transaction flagged on your card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is not my transaction! This is terrible, block the card now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Blocking it and raising a dispute.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your minimum due is Rs 2,300.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I will clear it on Monday. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your health policy is up for renewal next week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, please send me the premium details, I will renew it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sending the link now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Calling about your claim submitted last month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It has been 40 days, this is ridiculous. I want to escalate this and speak to a supervisor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will escalate it today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the status you would like to check?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My car insurance claim, the surveyor visited yesterday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It is under review and should be settled in 7 days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your premium of Rs 9,800 is pending.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll pay Rs 9,800 on Wednesday, thanks for calling.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am not happy with the renewal price, it went up a lot. I may cancel the policy.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check discounts.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your claim has been approved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's great news, thank you so much, very helpful.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How can I help with your order?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My parcel was not delivered but the app says delivered. I'm really upset.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will raise a ticket with the courier.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I returned the shoes a week ago and I still haven't got my refund.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The refund will reach you in 3 days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The phone arrived damaged. This is the worst experience, I want a supervisor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Transferring you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your refund of Rs 1,499 has been processed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thanks a lot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have a nice day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how may I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I change the delivery address for my order?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I have updated it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to know if you deliver to Pune.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, we do.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your EMI bounced this month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sorry, low balance. I will pay 6,000 rupees by Saturday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, noted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There is a late fee on your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I paid on time, this late fee is a wrong charge. Remove it or I will go to consumer court.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to renew your term policy?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not now, I am comparing other options.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, I'll call next week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was charged twice for one order, please refund the extra amount.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll check and refund it.
